# Volume 2 timeline

## PART TWO

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean), the narrator reflects on Captain Nemo's mysterious and vengeful nature. The narrator and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) observe various marine life, including a shoal of argonauts and a milk sea phenomenon, while [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) is eager to harpoon the aggressive sharks surrounding the vessel.

_Sources: [v2 PART TWO P2](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0002), [v2 PART TWO P6](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0006), [v2 PART TWO P21](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0021), [v2 PART TWO P25](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0025)_

## CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) approaches [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon), Captain Nemo invites [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and his companions to visit the pearl fisheries, casually mentioning the danger of sharks. [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) nervously discusses the offer with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), explaining how pearls are formed and harvested before revealing that they may encounter sharks in the water.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P2](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P20](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0020), [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)_

## CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — Captain Nemo leads [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a diving excursion off the coast of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon) to explore the pearl oyster banks, where they discover a giant tridacne oyster harboring an enormous pearl. While observing an Indian pearl diver, a shark attacks the fisherman. Captain Nemo and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) battle and kill the shark, saving the diver from death.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P25](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0025), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P31](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0031), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P40](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0040), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P46](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0046)_

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) saves Captain Nemo from a fierce shark attack, and [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) subsequently rescues the Cingalese pearl diver. After reviving the diver and gifting him a bag of pearls, the group returns to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) where [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) acknowledges Ned's help and expresses his sympathy for oppressed peoples.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P46](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0046), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P48](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0048), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P51](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0051), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P64](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0064)_

## CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md), Nautilus** — As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) discusses navigation and geology with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and later Captain Nemo. [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) reveals the existence of an underground passage beneath the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) that will allow them to reach the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) without rounding [Africa](../codex/places.md#africa).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P2](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P24](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0024), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P60](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0060), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P72](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0072)_

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) praises M. Lesseps's construction of the [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) Canal, but Captain Nemo reveals that the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) will reach the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) in two days via a subterranean route called the Arabian Tunnel. [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) explains how he deduced and confirmed the existence of this underground passage by tagging fish in the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) and recapturing them off the coast of [Syria](../codex/places.md#syria).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P57](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0057), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P60](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0060), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P74](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0074), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P78](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0078)_

## CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) spots a massive dugong, and Captain Nemo allows him to hunt it from a small boat. After a fierce battle where the creature turns on the boat, [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) kills it and it is brought aboard. Later, near [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez), Captain Nemo takes the helm and guides the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a subterranean passage under the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) into the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P10](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0010), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P63](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0063)_

## CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discusses escape plans with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) now that the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) has entered European waters in the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean). Later, off [Crete](../codex/places.md#crete), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) witnesses Captain Nemo send a massive chest of gold to a Greek diver named Pesca. Continuing their journey near [Santorin](../codex/places.md#santorin), Captain Nemo shows [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) a boiling submarine volcanic eruption before steering the vessel back into cooler waters.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P68](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0068), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P97](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0097), [v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P105](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0105)_

## CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) Sea at high speed, making escape impossible for [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) discuss geology and the eventual cooling of the Earth while navigating a shallow underwater ridge. On February 18th, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) passes through the Straits of [Gibraltar](../codex/places.md#gibraltar) and enters the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P1](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0001), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P25](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0025)_

## CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) informs [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) that he plans to escape from the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) that night as they pass near the Spanish coast. [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) nervously prepares for the escape, but before he can execute the plan, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) stops in [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay) and Captain Nemo interrupts him to recount the history of the sunken Spanish galleons while his crew harvests their treasure.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P50](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0050)_

**[Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) watches the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) crew collect gold and silver from sunken Spanish galleons in [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay). Captain Nemo explains how he gathers treasures from shipwrecks and hints that his vast wealth is used to aid suffering and oppressed humanity.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P52](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0052), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P56](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0056), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P63](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0063), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P64](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0064)_

## CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discuss their failed escape attempt and the Nautilus's current southward position. Later that night, Captain Nemo invites [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) on an underwater night excursion without lamps, guided by a glowing light in the distance. They trek across the ocean floor and climb an underwater volcano, revealing the sunken ruins of [Atlantis](../codex/places.md#atlantis).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P18](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0018), [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P28](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0028), [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P48](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0048)_

## CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) docks inside an extinct underwater volcano where Captain Nemo harvests sodium from coal deposits. Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) explore the volcano's subterranean interior, gathering honey, game, and plants before returning to the vessel.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P14](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0014), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P16](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0016), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P27](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0027)_

## CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA

**Nautilus, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates through the seaweed-dense [Sargasso Sea](../codex/places.md#sargasso-sea) and then travels across the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean. Captain Nemo takes the vessel to extreme deep-sea depths to conduct soundings and capture a photograph of the ocean floor before rapidly ascending to the surface.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA P0](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004), [v2 CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA P10](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0010), [v2 CHAPTER XI THE SARGASSO SEA P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014)_

## CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) discuss the potential crew size of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), highlighting Ned's growing frustration with his captivity. Later, when the vessel encounters a pod of whales, Captain Nemo refuses to allow [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) to hunt them, but instead uses the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to violently slaughter a attacking pack of aggressive cachalots.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P17](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0017), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P54](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0054), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P64](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0064)_

## CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Nautilus, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates through the treacherous [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) ice pack until it becomes completely blocked by an immense iceberg barrier. Captain Nemo proposes diving under the ice fields to reach the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole), and after discussing the logistics with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), he prepares the vessel and dives into the ocean depths to continue the journey south.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P2](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P12](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0012), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P35](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0035)_

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Nautilus, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) submerges to dive under the massive ice barrier and navigate toward the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole). [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) observe their progress from the saloon while the vessel periodically bumps against the underside of the thick ice ceiling. Early on March 19th, Captain Nemo enters the saloon to announce that they have reached open sea.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P35](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0035), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P39](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0039), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P40](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0040)_

## CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md)** — Captain Nemo and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) disembark on [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) land, claiming it as uncharted territory before exploring the area's unique flora and fauna alongside [Conseil](../character/conseil.md). Heavy fog and snow prevent [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) from taking solar measurements to confirm their exact position at the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole). With the March equinox approaching, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) explains how he plans to use the sun's position and a chronometer the following day to verify if they have truly reached the Pole.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P5](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0005), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P13](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0013), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P31](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0031), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P36](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0036)_

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Nautilus, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — On March 21st, Captain Nemo and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) climb a volcanic peak on land to observe the sun during the equinox. Using their instruments and chronometer at precisely noon, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) confirms that they have reached the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) and claims possession of the region under his own name.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P42](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0042), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P43](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0043), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P46](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0046)_

## CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT?

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md), Nautilus** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) collides with an overturned iceberg and is tipped onto its side beneath the ice. Captain Nemo manages to right the vessel, but as they attempt to navigate out of the ice tunnel, both the forward and rear exits are blocked by shifting icebergs, trapping the ship completely.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P23](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P60](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0060)_

## CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — Trapped in an iceberg with rapidly depleting oxygen, Captain Nemo and the crew work tirelessly to dig through the surrounding ice walls. Facing the additional threat of the surrounding water freezing around them, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) uses boiling water to prevent solidification and ultimately uses the weight of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to break through the final ice barrier into open water.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P14](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0014), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P18](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0018), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P34](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0034), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P44](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0044)_

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md), Nautilus** — Suffocating from lack of air, the crew and passengers endure extreme agony while Captain Nemo uses the Nautilus's weight and rams to break through the remaining ice. [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) save [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) by giving him their last saved air. Finally, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) breaches the ice surface, allowing fresh air to pour into the vessel.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P44](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0044), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P46](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0046), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — After escaping the ice, the passengers revive in the fresh air on the platform and realize the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is heading north through the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic). They continue past the coasts of South [America](../codex/places.md#america), collecting marine specimens along the way. [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) gets shocked when he grabs an electric ray, and the narrative details the various sea life encountered.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_

## CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md), Nautilus** — While discussing legends and facts about giant cuttlefish, the passengers observe enormous poulps attacking the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). When a creature gets caught in the propeller, Captain Nemo leads the crew onto the deck to fight the monsters, resulting in the loss of a French crewman before the creatures are repelled.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P38](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0038), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P50](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0050), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P58](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0058), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P61](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0061)_

## CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM

**[Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) pressures [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to ask Captain Nemo for their freedom as the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) sails along the [American](../codex/factions.md#american) coast near the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream). [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) confronts [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) in his room, but [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) firmly rejects releasing them, declaring they must remain on board forever. Afterward, as the vessel reaches [Long Island](../codex/places.md#long-island), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) deliberately stays at the surface to brave a violent hurricane before finally submerging into the deep.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P6](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0006), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P27](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0027), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P28](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0028), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P39](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0039)_

## CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels eastward across the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic), following the route of the transatlantic telegraph cable near [Ireland](../codex/places.md#ireland). It then turns south towards European waters while Captain Nemo searches for a precise location in the sea. Upon reaching the exact spot, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) submerges the vessel to reveal the historic underwater wreck of the French ship 'Le Vengeur'.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P6](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0006), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P9](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0009), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P14](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0014)_

## CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Nautilus, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — An unknown warship fires on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), prompting Captain Nemo to raise his black flag and declare his intent to sink the vessel in revenge. Despite [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) Land's hopes to escape to the attacking ship, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) submerges the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) and rams the vessel beneath its waterline, leaving the three companions helpless witnesses to its total destruction.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P49](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0049), [v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P51](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0051)_

## CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md)** — After days of frantic and isolated travel following the ship's destruction, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) informs the narrator that they are near land and will attempt their escape that night. As the narrator creeps past Captain Nemo playing the organ in the dark saloon, he hears [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) mournfully weeping. They join [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) in the small attached boat, but as [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) unbolts it, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) enters the deadly Norwegian maelstrom, ripping the small boat free and knocking the narrator unconscious.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO P23](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO P33](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0033), [v2 CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039)_

## CHAPTER XXIII CONCLUSION

**[Conseil](../character/conseil.md), France, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md)** — After escaping the maelstrom, Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) regains consciousness in a fisherman's hut in the Lofoten Isles alongside [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). While awaiting transport to return to [France](../codex/places.md#france), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) reflects on his ten-month underwater journey, revises his manuscript, and wonders about the ultimate fate of Captain Nemo and the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XXIII CONCLUSION P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 CHAPTER XXIII CONCLUSION P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER XXIII CONCLUSION P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 CHAPTER XXIII CONCLUSION P5](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0005)_
